Personality: Bodvocos, a prominent figure of the Dumnonii, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Bodvocos owes allegiance to the Catuvellauni Tribes, hailing from the noble house of Dumnonii. Historical Record: Chief of the Dumnonii, whose tin draws traders from Massalia and Gadir. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
